turnaround_reason: Fears that generative AI structurally disrupts the BPO/customer-experience model, plus a cut FY26 outlook and client offshoring, drove CNXC from the high-$50s to ~$19; the bull case is that its iX AI suite (contract signings +400% YoY) repositions it as an AI-orchestration play rather than a victim.
bullish_points: Trades at forward PE ~2.2 -- extreme deep-value if earnings hold
AI iX Suite bookings up ~400% YoY; management pivoting toward recurring AI revenue
Analyst consensus still Buy (7 buy / 2 hold, no sells)
Targeting net leverage below 2.6x EBITDA by end of FY26 (deleveraging path)
bearish_points: FY26 guide cut to just 0.25-1.25% constant-currency growth; core is eroding
Net debt ~$4.5B, debt/equity ~204 -- high leverage into a disrupted revenue base
Classic value-trap risk: cheap because the market prices AI as an existential threat
Basing but -13.9% below 200d MA; no confirmed reversal
catalyst: Proof that AI-suite revenue grows faster than legacy BPO erodes, stabilizing total revenue and margins
suggested_trade: Watchlist / very small speculative starter only; needs proof AI is a tailwind not a headwind before sizing
key_risk: AI accelerates client insourcing/offshoring faster than iX ramps, eroding revenue and pressuring the levered balance sheet
would_skip_if: Another guidance cut or AI bookings fail to convert to reported revenue growth
